questions.stem: The following statements concerning the abdominal part of the sympathetic trunk are not true except:
questions.stemHtml: The following statements concerning the abdominal part of the sympathetic trunk are not true except:

options.label: A
options.text: It enters the abdomen behind the lateral arcuate ligament

options.label: B
options.text: The trunk passes in 6 segmentally arranged ganglia

options.label: C
options.text: All the ganglia receive white rami communicantes

options.label: D
options.text: Gray rami communicantes are given off to the lumbar spinal nerves
